shortDescription: By Pietro LombardiSpanish gas grid operator Enagas BME:ENG said on Wednesday that the World Bank's International Centre for Settlement of Investment Disputes ordered Peru to allow Enagas to transfer abroad the dividends from its stake in gas infrastructure company Transportadora de Gas del Peru.

children: said on Wednesday that the World Bank's International Centre for Settlement of Investment Disputes ordered Peru to allow Enagas to transfer abroad the dividends from its stake in gas infrastructure company Transportadora de Gas del Peru.
The ruling applies to both the $178 million accrued and to future dividends, according to Enagas
Peru was also ordered to return a $65 million bank guarantee, the company said
Enagas has a stake of roughly 29% in the Peruvian company

According to Enagas filings to Spanish market regulator CNMV, Peru had blocked the transfer of dividends under a 2018 domestic law to ensure companies retain funds in Peru to cover potential civil reparations
Enagas said it was committed to keeping a constructive dialogue with the Peruvian government to implement the ruling

title: Spain's Enagas wins arbitration ruling against Peru over blocked dividends
